author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: Exported faksimil source-pair helper has no production caller.
findings.consequence: The module keeps an extra exported abstraction and test surface that does not protect current reader behavior; future changes can preserve or adapt unused behavior unnecessarily.
findings.evidence: Repository search for `facsimileSourcePair` outside its own unit finds only the unit test import/assertion. The reader API builds `sources` directly with `buildFacsimileSources`, and the Vue reader component computes selected and retina sources from `page.sources` itself.
findings.recommendation: Delete `facsimileSourcePair` and remove its unit-test assertion unless a production caller is introduced; keep pairing logic in the actual consumer or extract it only when shared by real callers.
verification: `rg -n "facsimileSourcePair" server app shared test --glob '!test/unit/reader-source.spec.ts'` returned only `server/utils/reader-source.ts:250`.
Inspected `server/api/reader/[author]/[title]/[page]/[mediatype].get.ts` lines 124-142: faksimil pages expose all built sources, not this pair helper.
Inspected `app/components/reader/ReaderFacsimileImage.vue` lines 21-42: the component computes selected and retina sources directly.
Inspected `test/unit/reader-source.spec.ts` lines 526-536: the listed test is the only external assertion of this helper.
Inspected packet-listed imports/types: `shared/types/reader.ts`, `shared/utils/facsimile-source.ts`, and direct faksimil reader call sites.
